verdict.rationale: Mastra docs show per-tool approval gating (`requireApproval: true` with `tool-call-approval` stream chunks), a 'Code mode' that runs multi-tool computations in an isolated sandbox, and enterprise RBAC/IAM/network-policy controls — directly covering both fine-grained tool permissions and sandboxed execution. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the sandbox's isolation guarantees, and detail on how granular (per-tool vs per-agent) permission scoping actually works in practice beyond the single approval flag.
